s: Din tzedoqi umumar beerub ubo d' seipim: hatztzedoqim hem keyisrael umebattelim reshut, veen tzarik liskor mehem kede leharchiq dirato mehem, hoil vehem shomere shabbat veenam obedim elilim. Abal erub shellahem eno moil, kevan sheenam modim beerub:
Kuti hare hu kishar nokrim, veen lo taqqana ella biskirut:

Yisrael mumar laaboda zara o lechallel shabbatot beparhesya, apillu eno mechallelo ella beissure dibre soperim — hare hu kenokri lekol debarayv vetzarik liskor mimmennu. Veeno domeh litzdoqi, shehem mechallelim gam ken beissure dibre soperim beparhesya, lepi shehatztzedoqim anusim hem, shemmaaseh abotehem bidehem. Veim eno mechallelo ella betzina, apillu mechallelo beissure tora — hare hu keyisrael lekol debarayv, umebattel reshut (o meareb). Veeno niqra "mumar lechallel shabbatot beparhesya" ella kesheragil bekak veeno nizhar kelal, abal lo keshechillelo paam beaqray beolma, keshehaya dachuq lepi shaa:

Yisrael shehemir, veyesh lo bayit bishkunat hayyehudim sheerebu lekol hashshana, vegam hu ereb immahem — im en lo petach acheret kelal ella lishkuna zo, hare hu oser bekol shabbat shechal leachar shehemir ad sheyyaskir, shekkebar nitbattel erubo keshehemir laaboda zara. Abal im yesh lo petach acher lishkunat hannokrim, apillu hu petach qatan vetzar (sheeno ragil bo leolam, vaapillu eno petach gamur ella challon d' al d') — eno oser alehem (lepi shebbeoto petach o challon happetuchim lishkunat hannokrim hu chapetz bahem yoter mibbepetach haggadol shellishkunat hayyehudim, kevan shehemir ledatam, venaasa petach zeh keillu eno ragil lelek bo kelal lishkunat hayyehudim, veeno oser alehem ap al pi shemmaknis umotzi derek alehem gemallim uqeronot kol hayyom kullo, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shp"t):
